questions.prompt: How should the code be organized for the eulerian edge traversal approach to Reconstruct Itinerary?

choices.label: Mark airports visited and forbid revisiting them.
choices.feedback: Airports may repeat; tickets, not vertices, are consumed once.

choices.label: Append each next airport immediately and never revise dead ends.
choices.feedback: A lexical choice can end early; finishing-order assembly preserves all tickets.

choices.label: Order outgoing destinations lexically and consume each ticket during recursive traversal. Append airports when their outgoing tickets are exhausted, then reverse the route.
choices.feedback: That matches the selected approach. Order outgoing destinations lexically and consume each ticket during recursive traversal. Append airports when their outgoing tickets are exhausted, then reverse the route.
